orchestrator_action_items: PHASE-A dd15 MISREAD -- recorded so it is not repeated. The regime-classifier read dd15=0.000% as 'today's close IS the 15-day high' and built a 'fundamentally-anchored breakout / genuine trend-continuation' conclusion on it, asserting a fresh high twice. OHLC says 3rd-highest close, -0.10% below the 08-07 max, and a faded CPI print. This is the EXACT failure the _regime.py docstring warns about ('a peak-based re-derivation gives a different number and silently changes which arm of the crash guard fires'). The corrected read points the OPPOSITE way and matches the agent's own breadth/rotation caveats. Generalizable lesson: regime_check.py --claim-label/--claim-ret10 arbitrates NUMBERS, and the numbers were right here -- it was the INTERPRETATION of a metric definition that was wrong, which no existing arbitration catches. Any lane figure carrying a directional conclusion needs checking against the source definition, not just against regime_check.py.

STANDING METHODOLOGICAL GAP -- lane/harness SELECTION-RULE mismatch. The live OI_FADE lane ranks by rel_build; the harness that produced the +0.59%/n=1087 baseline selects top-15 by RAW oi_net_5d with NO persistence, catalyst_split, or rel_build filter (retro_harness.py:82-99). All five candidates pass every harness gate but rank 28-192 of 1,359 gated names, so the prior is BORROWED for a differently-ranked population rather than measured for this selection rule. The harness's own top-15 tonight is mega-cap/crypto-beta (SPCX, MSTR, PCG, DKNG, META, AAPL, MARA, TSLA, NFLX, AMZN...), which is the 'raw = mega-cap beta short' artifact the relative screen exists to avoid -- so the live lane's deviation is defensible, but it is undocumented and unmeasured. This is the ranking-metric sibling of the known 'patch the lane, not the harness' defect. DECISION NEEDED: either add the live screens to the harness and re-baseline, or record explicitly that the live prior is inherited rather than measured. Any change must clear retro_harness.py --all first. NOTE: the lane's 5d SUM and features' oi_net_5d are the SAME metric exactly 5x apart (mean vs sum) -- ranking is preserved, so this is a selection-rule difference, NOT a data bug.
